body.arabic_rules: Use `leading-relaxed` for Arabic text to ensure diacritics are not clipped. Avoid `tracking-tight` or negative letter-spacing for Arabic as it connects letters incorrectly and reduces readability.

colors.theme: Light theme prioritized for workshop environments (high visibility under sunlight)

layouts.mobile_first: Always start with single column (grid-cols-1 or flex-col) and scale up using sm:, md:, lg: prefixes.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Protocol Mode B: grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 sm:gap-4. Use explicit aspect ratios or heights to keep cards consistent.
layouts.spacing: Use generous padding inside cards (p-4 sm:p-6). Maintain gap-4 between sections.
rtl_rules: Use logical properties: ps-* (padding-inline-start), pe-* (padding-inline-end), ms-* (margin-inline-start), me-* (margin-inline-end).
Use text-start and text-end instead of text-left/text-right.
Ensure icons have ms-2 or me-2 based on their placement relative to text in RTL.

components.stats_card: Remove complex inline styles. Use Tailwind CSS. For mobile, use flex-col, ensuring the icon and value are easily scannable. Expandable states should be smooth.
components.vehicle_card: Clean up absolute positioning. Use flex/grid for robust alignment. Ensure tap targets for quick actions (the dots menu) are at least 44x44px. Wrap statuses in horizontal scrollable containers if they overflow.
components.visit_card: In VehicleDetails.jsx, optimize data tables for mobile. Avoid `<table className="w-full">` breaking on small screens. Convert table rows into a card-based stack or CSS grid layout on screens < 640px.
components.filters: Make the search and filter pills sticky below the header on mobile. Use `overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap hide-scrollbar` for status filter pills to allow easy swiping.

accessibility.tap_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all interactive elements (buttons, icons, dropdowns, inputs) on mobile.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-slate-600 or darker on slate-50/white backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testid: CRITICAL: Preserve all existing `data-testid` attributes exactly as they are for E2E testing compatibility.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Open `Dashboard.jsx` and `VehicleDetails.jsx`. Focus on replacing brittle inline styles with robust, mobile-first Tailwind CSS.
2. Standardize RTL support using Tailwind's logical properties (`ps-`, `pe-`, `ms-`, `me-`, `text-start`, `text-end`, `rounded-s-`, `rounded-e-`). Avoid hardcoded `ml-`/`pr-`.
3. Dashboard Grid: Refactor the top stats widgets into a responsive Bento grid (`grid-cols-2` on mobile, `grid-cols-4` on desktop). Ensure text sizes and icons scale gracefully.
4. Search & Filters: On mobile, wrap the filter bar in a sticky container (`sticky top-0 z-30 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md pb-2`) so it remains accessible when scrolling down the vehicle list.
5. Vehicle Cards: Use flexbox and gap utilities to manage spacing. Make sure the vehicle plate pill and badges don't overlap or overflow off-screen on an iPhone SE.

6. Vehicle Details (`VisitCard` & `VisitItemRow`): Refactor the HTML `<table>` to be responsive. On mobile screens (`< sm`), change `tr` and `td` to `block` or use a stacked flex layout per item so inputs don't squash.

7. Fixed Action Bar: In `VehicleDetails.jsx`, implement a sticky bottom action bar (`fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 bg-white shadow-[0_-4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] z-50`) on mobile view for 'Save' and 'Complete Visit' buttons. This prevents infinite scrolling to save changes.
8. Preserve core logic: Do not alter existing API calls, state management, window events, or localStorage usage. Only alter the UI rendering and CSS classes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this. Create distinct, functional interfaces.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Dark colors look good when used independently.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) where appropriate (e.g., sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Use specific transitions to prevent transform breaking.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Align to natural reading flow (RTL -> text-start).
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations (`active:scale-95`).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use `lucide-react` which is already imported.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, selection states.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
For Arabic UI, prioritize legible font sizes and line heights (`leading-relaxed`).
CRITICAL: Do not use complete `transparent` background in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content scrolling under it.
